rationale: On mornings with an 08:30 economic release the number moves NQ far in one direction in minutes, so a pair of stop orders placed around the price before the print catches that move whichever way it goes, and a wide enough bracket survives the first whipsaw; the main setting is how far from the price the orders sit, in ATR. Losing side: Traders who fade or hold positions into the release and are run over by the move, and market makers who quote tight into the print.
notes: C straddle: at session start (+ delay_min), OCO stop entries at last price +/- off_atr x ATR. 2025-26 was already seen once for this family's old finalist (straddle-tf30 nyam / pm): the EXAM is a SECOND look
